title: Metadata Sync support for Delta Checkpoint V2 (Generally Available)

content.text: Metadata Sync support for Delta Checkpoint V2 lets both legacy and new Metadata Sync discover and synchronize Delta tables that use the Checkpoint V2 format. For more information, see SQL analytics endpoint metadata synchronization.
